capabilities.goal: Implement the unfinished 'quality-evaluation' capability in the TeluAI roadmap, delivering a functional module that can assess the quality of generated AI outputs, expose a clean API, and integrate with existing CI pipelines.

steps.title: Repository audit for quality‑evaluation artifacts
steps.objective: Locate existing placeholders, tests, and documentation related to the quality‑evaluation feature; identify missing files, entry points, and CI expectations.
steps.verification: Audit report exists and identifies implementation, test, and CI gaps.

steps.title: Define quality metrics and evaluation schema
steps.objective: Specify relevance, coherence, factual accuracy, and toxicity metrics and the JSON schema returned by evaluation.
steps.verification: Pydantic schema exists, is strict, normalized to 0..1, tested, and documented.

steps.title: Create core evaluation engine skeleton
steps.objective: Implement a QualityEvaluator with explicit hooks for each metric and stable schema output.
steps.verification: Evaluator imports, exposes all required metric methods/hooks, and unit tests pass.

steps.title: Implement metric algorithms
steps.objective: Add deterministic or provider-backed implementations for the defined metrics without weakening safety boundaries.
steps.verification: Metric implementations have focused tests and documented limitations.

steps.title: Expose evaluation API
steps.objective: Add a clean application-facing quality evaluation interface using the established schema.
steps.verification: API contract, validation, error handling, and tests pass.

steps.title: Integrate evaluation into response pipeline
steps.objective: Connect quality evaluation to generated-response processing behind an explicit, safe integration boundary.
steps.verification: Integration tests demonstrate evaluation receives the intended prompt/response data.

steps.title: Add regression and safety coverage
steps.objective: Cover malformed input, score bounds, unsafe output signals, and failure isolation.
steps.verification: Regression and safety tests pass without changing existing behavior unexpectedly.

steps.title: Integrate quality checks into CI
steps.objective: Run the quality-evaluation test suite as part of repository CI.
steps.verification: CI executes the quality-evaluation tests and remains green.

steps.title: Document evaluator usage
steps.objective: Document configuration, contract, limitations, and extension points.
steps.verification: Documentation is complete and examples match the implementation.

steps.title: Benchmark evaluation path
steps.objective: Measure evaluation latency and resource use with representative offline inputs.
steps.verification: A reproducible benchmark result is recorded without requiring production secrets.

steps.title: Security and reliability review
steps.objective: Review trust boundaries, secret handling, failure modes, and abuse resistance.
steps.verification: Focused review findings are resolved or explicitly documented.

steps.title: Release readiness check
steps.objective: Validate the completed capability against repository quality gates and prepare its roadmap completion record.
steps.verification: Full CI and offline evaluation are green and capability state is persisted as complete.

capabilities.goal: Improve bounded performance monitoring and optimization.

steps.title: Repository performance assessment
steps.objective: Identify current latency and resource hotspots.
steps.verification: Assessment is recorded and testable improvements are identified.

capabilities.goal: Strengthen authentication, authorization, secret handling, and auditability.

steps.title: Security baseline assessment
steps.objective: Audit current security controls and identify prioritized gaps.
steps.verification: Security baseline and remediation priorities are recorded.

steps.title: UX baseline assessment
steps.objective: Audit the current interface for usability and accessibility gaps.
steps.verification: UX findings are recorded with actionable priorities.

steps.title: Production readiness assessment
steps.objective: Audit runtime, deployment, observability, and operational controls.

capabilities.goal: Prepare a controlled production release lifecycle.

steps.title: Release readiness assessment
steps.objective: Audit versioning, release checks, documentation, and rollback expectations.
steps.verification: Release checklist and remaining blockers are recorded.
